body.x: MPS Korea Co., Ltd (CEO YANG KIIL) participated in ‘CES 2023’, held in Las Vegas, USA for 4 days between January 5th (Thurs) and 8th (Sun, local time).

MPS Korea is a company that has developed and manufactured golf carts, and lithium battery packs and many related parts. Since their establishment in 2002, they have been reborn as a venture capital and INNO-BIZ company through continuous corporate growth and technological improvement, and has been recognized for their excellent business potential, such as being selected as a G-STAR company.

As the need for new and renewable energy is growing very strong in the global industry, they are focusing on developing advanced battery pack technology that can be applied to various application fields. Their products are produced through a conforming quality management system including international standards such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and GMP13485.

In this exhibition, MPS Korea showcased their various electricity·power systems. Their flagship product, the lithium-ion battery pack, is available for a wide range of applications, from stationary UPS devices to electric vehicles. It is characterized by the application of state-of-the-art battery pack technologies such as battery cell balancing, BMS board, and positioning.

They also presented a rectifier for 5G communication with a UPS battery system and a two-way inverter. This is a 1.2kw, 3kw rectifier that can be connected in parallel, and can be used for the development of a backup battery system using LG lithium cells and various battery and charger systems linked to small electric vehicles. The power conversion efficiency is over 95%, and it supports AC·DC two-way inverting, boasting high utilization. In addition, IP68 waterproof and dustproof makes it possible to be installed outdoors, and all parts and materials are made of eco-friendly materials.
At the same time, MPS Korea plans to introduce a hybrid PCS that is easy to solve issues in the power environment of developing countries overseas.

An official from MPS Korea said, “As we are participating in CES with the goal of entering the global market, we are looking for an investment partner to build a sales agency and production line in the US.” They explained their reasons for participation of this exhibition by saying, “Based on a product lineup that has secured reliability in lithium batteries, rectifiers, and chargers, we are positively judging the possibility.”

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.
